text:
anya: Heads-up — Sam has submitted resignation, last day is Fri 2026-05-14. We need SSO deprovision the following Monday, confirm COBRA/benefits timeline, pro-rata bonus calc, and laptop return shipping. @michael can you confirm last working day and any planned handoff sessions?

michael: Confirmed — last billable day is 2026-05-14, but Sam will do two knowledge-transfer sessions Mon/Tue before.

sam: Yep — will record the runbook and leave notes in the repo. Laptop needs to go back from Berlin. Happy to drop at DHL pickup.

anya: Thanks. Quick checklist I'm tracking: 1) SSO offboard (dev, staging, prod) 2) GitHub org access 3) Slack deprovision 4) Payroll final pay + bonus proration 5) Benefits/COBRA opt-in email 6) Laptop pickup/shipping customs.

it-ops: I'll schedule SSO deprovision for Mon 2026-05-17 09:00 UTC. Need exact GitHub org teams Sam is in — @michael please list teams or give repo perms to transfer.

michael: Sam is in teams: "inference-core", "realtime-gpu", "oncall-rotations". I'll transfer ownership on repos: inference-runtime, auto-batching.

payroll: For final pay we need: last timesheet submitted, any outstanding expense reports, and confirmation of bonus eligibility/period. What's Sam's bonus plan?

michael: Sam is on 10% annual performance bonus, pro-rated by days active this fiscal year. He joined 2024-09-02. Can payroll compute pro-rata from 2026-01-01 to 2026-05-14?

payroll: Got it — we'll compute pro-rata using company policy (calendar days active / 365 * target bonus). Expect a calc and payout on final payroll run (next cycle). I'll DM for bank details check.

benefits: COBRA only applies to US employees. Sam is in Germany on an EMEA contract — we'll trigger a benefits offboarding email with options for local health continuation vendors. Sam, confirm whether you were on company healthcare or a local plan we supplemented.

sam: I was on the local German health plan but paying employer supplement. Need what options exist for continuing supplement after leaving.

benefits: We'll send an email with 1) final coverage end date (last day 2026-05-14) 2) options for employer-supplement continuation (typically 3 months available via payroll arrangement) 3) contact for documentation. Expect email by EOD today.

anya: Shipping — since it's cross-border, please include commercial invoice and remove any company data first. @shipping-bot can you generate the prefilled label for Berlin -> Redwood HQ RMA? Attach customs CN23?

shipping-bot: Generated draft label: 
```
From: Sam <sam@example.de>
To: Redwood Inference HQ Returns
Service: DHL Express International
Customs: Company-owned laptop, value EUR 1200, HS code 8471.30
RMA: RMA-2026-198
```
Please confirm and I'll email pickup slot link.

sam: OK to ship with that. I'll also factory-reset after backup. Any secure wipe checklist?

it-ops: Please follow secure wipe: 1) backup to encrypted S3 bucket 2) revoke SSH keys 3) factory reset 4) confirm serial + MAC in thread. We will check device on receipt.

anya: On SSO timing — we'll deprovision workstation access Mon morning but keep GitHub org read access for 48 hours for handoff, then remove. Is that acceptable?

it-ops: Yes that's fine. We'll run deprovision job: `offboard --user sam --phases lock-workstation,remove-cloud-keys,delay-github-48h` (this runs at 09:00 UTC Mon).

hr-bot: Reminder: please run the exit interview form (link) before final day. Sam, do you prefer virtual or written exit interview?

sam: Virtual please — Wed 2026-05-12 at 14:00 CEST works.

anya: I'll schedule exit interview and send calendar invite. payroll: once you DM Sam for bank details, add any expense claims to final run. Also note potential bonus proration — michael, please confirm any partial months off-cycle (vacation) that affect days active.

michael: No unpaid leave during the period. All good.

payroll: Noted. I'll update final run and confirm payout date in this thread once processed.

anya: Closing checklist items assigned: it-ops (deprovision job), benefits (offboarding email + local continuation options), payroll (final pay + pro-rata calc), shipping-bot (label & pickup), michael (repo ownership transfers), sam (backup + factory reset). Ping here when each is done. :+1:

it-ops: Deprovision job scheduled and will post completion with run ID.

shipping-bot: DHL pickup scheduled for 2026-05-15 10:30 CEST. Tracking: 123456789DE.

payroll: Pro-rata bonus calc posted via DM and final payout scheduled for 2026-05-20 payroll run.

benefits: Offboarding email sent to Sam with supplement continuation options and docs.

anya: Thanks team — marking as monitoring until final payroll and device receipt are confirmed.

sam: Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. Appreciate it.
